description: This PHP class 'StateContainer' manages application state for an installer module. It handles storing and retrieving configuration data, session management, and application state related to database configuration, versioning, registration, and session attributes for the OrangeHRM HRM system installer.

classes.name: StateContainer
classes.description: A singleton class managing session-based application state related to the installer process, including database info, versioning, admin and organization data, and lifecycle flags.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the StateContainer class.

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Sets a session attribute with a given name and value.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a session attribute by name, with optional default.

methods.name: hasAttribute
methods.description: Checks if a session attribute exists.

methods.name: storeDbInfo
methods.description: Stores database connection information into the session.

methods.name: getDbInfo
methods.description: Returns the stored database info from session.

methods.name: isSetDbInfo
methods.description: Checks if database info has been set.

methods.name: setCurrentScreen
methods.description: Sets the current installer screen and upgrade mode.

methods.name: isUpgrader
methods.description: Determines if the current mode is an upgrader.

methods.name: storeInstanceData
methods.description: Stores organization and locale data for the instance.

methods.name: getInstanceData
methods.description: Retrieves stored organization and locale data.

methods.name: storeInitialRegistrationData
methods.description: Stores initial registration data and tracking flags.

methods.name: getInitialRegistrationData
methods.description: Retrieves initial registration data and related flags.

methods.name: isMigrationCompleted
methods.description: Checks if migration has been completed.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Resets session while preserving current screen and upgrade status.
